build.buildCommand: bun prisma generate && PRISMA_CLIENT_DIR=$(dirname "$(find node_modules -path '*/.prisma/client/index.js' | head -n 1)") && mkdir -p node_modules/.prisma && cp -R "$PRISMA_CLIENT_DIR" node_modules/.prisma/client && bun run build

deploy.startCommand: bun prisma db:push && bun run --cwd apps/next start -p ${PORT:-3000}
